text: mon review: read #101 #100 #102 #103 #106 #107 #108 and coordinator commits 955773e 72fe57f. No gaming, no frozen-path change through a PR, no model call, keys stay stripped from child commands. One doubt for P02/P06 (h05, h07): src/solve/loop.ts solve() calls decide() (one Welch screen at alpha 0.1) for train and for holdout, not decideWithConfirm() (screen 0.1 then confirm at 0.005 on fresh runs). decide.ts says a screen alone keeps too many no-ops. mon review (doubt, not reverted) #132 measure draft (h01): compareEnv() passes SYNTHE_* keys to the drafted compare.js during the agreement check. Accepted as a narrow, documented exception: the key goes only to Anthropic, a loopback base, or the base_url baked into the script, with redirect: error. Two points. (1) For provider anthropic, compareEnv also forwards SYNTHE_API_KEY when it does not start with sk-ant- (compare.js ignores it, but it should not get it). Please tighten. (2) Under solve, commandCompare runs compare.js through runCommand, which strips SYNTHE_*, so the drafted judge gets no key. If S0x needs that, pass only the provider's key to that one judge command. Do NOT forward SYNTHE_* to measure, guard, run or proposer commands; that would undo the key isolation from #101. No real call in tests (loopback fake).

mon review (doubt, not reverted) #122 judged measure in solve (h06): good that model-judge questions now count against max_calls (closes my watch item). Two points. (1) A judged problem with split.holdout true passes problem check and the summary says 'Holdout: on', but solve() replaces steps.decide for judged measures, so no holdout step runs. That silently skips a guard the person asked for. Either refuse split.holdout with measure.judge in problem.ts (one plain line), or apply it (for example hold back a share of the cases). Do not leave it silent. (2) max_calls is checked only at round start; one judged round can ask cases x 2 x 2 x candidates questions and overshoot. Before max_usd enforcement (S0x) lands, check the budget before each model call, as GOAL-2.md says ('stop before a model call that would take the known cost above'). #138 (max_usd validation only) is clean; I will check enforcement when it lands.

mon review (doubt, not reverted) #135 (h07): guard reasons now show the failing lines, which is good for guards. But commandFailure() also builds the reason when the measure fails on the holdout split (loop.ts: 'the held-back split gave no number: ...' and 'Could not measure the held-back split: ...'). That reason goes to the proposer's history, so holdout output (for example a failing holdout case and its expected value) can reach the proposer. The path predates #135, but #135 makes such lines more likely to appear. Please make a holdout failure reason say only that the held-back split failed, with no output; keep the detail for report.md only if it is not passed to history. P07 says the proposer never sees holdout results.

Please reserve the estimated cost (dearest) at the check, or run model-judge questions one at a time while max_usd is set. (b) #135 holdout output in failure reasons is still open. (c) #132 compareEnv should not forward a non-sk-ant SYNTHE_API_KEY.

mon review: #144 (closes my #132 compareEnv point), #146 (parallel calls reserve the dearest cost: closes my #140 max_usd point) and #145 (judge rubric only via compare model, rubric protected, no key to commands) are clean. #147 (h05), doubt, not reverted: measurePathsOf now lets a proposal edit a file named in a measure or guard command when artifact names it exactly. No zoo or practice problem uses this path, so it is not tuned to a check, and protect still wins. Risk: a person who lists an expected-answers file (for example 'python3 score.py expected.txt' with artifact ['expected.txt']) lets the proposer change the answers. Suggest: keep it editable but say so in problem check ('expected.txt is read by the measure and is in artifact: a change to it changes the score'), or refuse when the file is an argument of measure.command (not a guard). Also: #147 merged after the pause order; coordinator-1 (holdout leak) has not landed yet.
